meta.title: IBSU — Applicants
meta.description: Programmes, tuition, internal grants and admission steps for future students of International Black Sea University, Tbilisi.

chapters.line: Every story starts with a question.
Then, one day, you go looking for the answer.
Every step, a little taller. Every year, a little braver.
Until you find the place where it all comes together.

hero.title: Georgia’s first English-language university.
hero.lede: Five schools, one courtyard. IBSU brings world-class, practice-based education — and the partnership of MIT, the world’s leading university — to the heart of Tbilisi.

programs.title: Choose the story you want to write.
programs.lede: 18 bachelor’s programmes across five schools, taught in Georgian, English or both. Prices are annual tuition before grants.

admission.title: Four steps to your first day.

steps.title: Register for the Unified National Exams
steps.body: Admission to IBSU is based on the results of the Unified National Exams, run by the National Assessment and Examinations Center (NAEC).

steps.title: Put IBSU — code 064 — first
steps.body: When you list programmes during registration, give IBSU first place. It matters for enrolment, and it earns you a 20% IBSU Priority grant.

steps.title: Sit the exams and get your results
steps.body: Your scores decide enrolment — and whether you land in the TOP 50 or TOP 51–150 for a 50% or 25% grant.

steps.title: Enrol at IBSU
steps.body: Sign your contract, choose a payment plan — Georgian citizens can spread tuition over 8 months — and start your first semester.

intl.title: Applying from abroad?
intl.body: International students pay $4,900 a year with scholarships of up to $1,000 ($5,900 and up to $500 for Medicine).

tuition.title: See what you’d really pay.
tuition.lede: Pick a programme and the grants you qualify for. Only the highest single grant applies.
tuition.keep: To keep a grant, your GPA must stay above 71 at the end of each year.

top50.title: TOP 50
top50.body: Among the top 50 students enrolled through the national exams.

gold.title: Gold medal
gold.body: You graduated school with a gold medal.

priority.title: IBSU Priority
priority.body: You listed IBSU first at exam registration.

creative.title: Creative tour
creative.body: Architecture or Graphic Design — pass IBSU’s creative tour.

explore.title: Try IBSU on before it’s yours.

cards.title: Open Day
cards.body: Visit the campus and get your questions answered in person.

cards.title: Career guidance
cards.body: Advice and practical exercises from successful specialists to help you plan your career.

cards.title: Choose a profession
cards.body: Take the tests and find out which field fits you best.

items.q: How do I get into IBSU?
items.a: Through the Unified National Exams. When you register, put IBSU (code 064) first in your list of programmes.
Yes. IBSU is Georgia’s first English-language university. Programmes are taught in English, Georgian or both — each card above shows the language.
No — if you qualify for two or more internal grants, the highest one applies.

items.q: How do I keep my grant?
items.a: Keep your GPA above 71 at the end of every academic year.
Georgian citizens can spread tuition over 8 months with a flexible payment schedule.
